title: Tai Peoples and Their Languages: A Preliminary Observation (Comparative Khamyang, Phake, and Aiton)
author: Prof. Suriya Ratanakul
description: Scholarly comparative monograph from the Institute of Language and Culture for Rural Development, Mahidol University, examining the phonological correspondences, tone split developments, and lexical cognates between the five Tai groups of Assam: Khamyang, Phake, Aiton, Khamti, and Turung.
